(`boxTagOfTy`, `mvValKindOfTy`, an `*OfTy` / `*Ty` reader) rather than
rendering with `tyToEmitName` and parsing the spelling back. Rendering is for
output — module names, diagnostics, printable keys (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §4.1).
